commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one square skill or status icon for a stylized dark-fantasy miniature RPG, displayed at 40px in combat and 24px for statuses. Generate one standalone icon, not a sheet or UI mockup. Style: hand-painted fantasy game ability art, chunky sculptural forms and one strong readable silhouette, restrained details, rich material shading, painterly edges. Background: softly lit dark forest-charcoal (#101b19), matching an antique gold and forest-black game interface. Composition: one large centered emblem filling 75% of the square with a 12% safe margin. No border, no lettering, no numbers, no text, no watermark, no extra miniature characters. Must remain immediately recognizable at 32px. Square image.
